metadata.description: Claude plugins from the AI Growth Systems Bootcamp. GTM context: build your go-to-market context layer (product, ICP, competitors, customer language, objections, shareable customers) in Notion + GitHub or GitHub only.

plugins.name: gtm-context-notion
plugins.description: GTM context that lives in Notion: one GTM Hub page, short context pages and queryable databases for competitors, objections and customers.

plugins.name: gtm-context-github
plugins.description: GTM context that lives in your own GitHub repo: a gtm/ folder with short markdown pages and CSV banks for competitors, objections and customers.
